text: Offers official type-safe SDKs/client libraries in multiple languages (TypeScript, Python, Java, Go, Ruby, PHP, C#)
quote: Type-safe SDKs in multiple languages, including TypeScript, Python, Java, Go, Ruby, PHP, and C#

text: Official CLI can initialize projects, validate API definitions, preview changes locally, and publish docs/SDKs
quote: The Fern CLI lets you initialize projects, validate API definitions, preview changes locally, and publish documentation and SDKs.

text: Visual web editor lets non-technical teammates update docs without code, markdown, or git
quote: Fern Editor lets team members such as content writers, product managers, and marketers update documentation without code, markdown, or Git.

text: Built-in AI assistant (Ask Fern) indexes docs and answers reader questions with citations linking to source pages
quote: Ask Fern indexes your documentation and provides an interface for your end users to ask questions and get answers. Responses include citations that link directly to source pages.

text: Automatically generates and hosts a production MCP server for each docs site so agents can query it
quote: Fern automatically generates and hosts a production-ready Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for every documentation site with Ask Fern enabled.

text: Provides an MCP server developers can register with their coding agent to look up docs.yml syntax, components, CLI commands, and site/deployment status
quote: Register it with your coding agent to look up `docs.yml` syntax, components, and CLI commands while you build, and to read your sites, deployments, and reader activity without leaving your terminal.

text: Every published page is available as clean Markdown by appending .md/.mdx to the URL
quote: Fern serves clean Markdown for any documentation page so agents can consume your content efficiently. Agents fetch the source by appending `.md` or `.mdx` to a page URL

text: Automatically generates and maintains an llms.txt file so AI tools can discover and index the docs
quote: Fern implements this standard, automatically generating and maintaining an `llms.txt` Markdown file so AI tools can discover and index your documentation.

text: Fern Agent can run on a schedule, review reader feedback/unanswered questions/analytics, and open a pull request with suggested changes
quote: You can now put Fern Agent on a schedule... Automations can review your reader feedback, unanswered Ask Fern questions, search queries, or analytics, report back what it found, and open a pull request when the prompt asks for a change.

text: GraphQL API reference pages are auto-generated for every named type in the schema, grouped by kind
quote: GraphQL API References now include a page for every named type in your schema, collected under a `Types` section at the API Reference root and grouped by kind: Objects, Inputs, Enums, Scalars, Interfaces, and Unions.

text: Pages can carry custom key-value search-metadata frontmatter for custom search integrations to filter/group by
quote: You can now attach your own key-value metadata to a page with the `search-metadata` frontmatter object... so a custom search integration can group and filter results by your own taxonomy.

text: Self-hosted container can resolve environment variables per request, letting one image serve multiple differing deployments
quote: A self-hosted container can now resolve environment variables in the pages it serves, on each request... so one image serves deployments that differ only in those values.

text: Offers a white-glove migration service for customers moving from existing documentation (Enterprise plan)
quote: If you're migrating from existing documentation, Fern provides a white-glove migration service as part of the Enterprise plan.

text: Supports versioned docs with a dropdown; each version can have its own tabs, sections, pages, and API references
quote: Versions add a dropdown to your docs for multiple releases of the same content. Each version can contain its own tabs, sections, pages, and API references, and versions can share content.

text: Local preview server shows documentation changes instantly with hot reload, including offline after first run
quote: Run a local preview server to view documentation changes instantly with hot reload. Offline access is available after the first online run.

text: Supports custom domains for docs: subdomain, subpath, or root domain
quote: You can configure any of the following custom domain types: Subdomain: `docs.mydomain.com`, Subpath: `mydomain.com/docs`, Root domain: `mydomain.com`

text: Docs sites can serve the product's own Agent Skills, discoverable and installable via a skills CLI
quote: Fern Docs sites can serve your own Agent Skills so your users can discover and install them with the skills CLI.

text: Lets you override the default agent-crawling directive via an 'agents' key in docs.yml
quote: To override the default, set a custom directive using the `agents` key in `docs.yml`

text: Analytics tab reports llms.txt usage/traffic broken down by LLM provider (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, etc.)
quote: The tab reports `llms.txt` usage including: Traffic by LLM provider (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, etc.)

text: Supports password-protecting documentation pages
quote: Password-protected docs

text: Supports visitor authentication via JWT or SSO for gated docs
quote: Visitor authentication (JWT, SSO)

text: Generates API reference documentation automatically from an OpenAPI specification
quote: Fern supports writing pages in Markdown and generating API Reference documentation from an OpenAPI specification.

text: Lets writers author documentation pages in Markdown
quote: Fern supports writing pages in Markdown and generating API Reference documentation from an OpenAPI specification.

text: MCP server connects AI coding clients (Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf) to docs so readers get answers inside their dev environment
quote: The server connects AI clients like Claude Code, Cursor, and Windsurf to your documentation as an external data source, so your readers can get instant answers about your product directly within their development environment.

text: Fern Agent can read a docs site's source repository and make the changes described in a prompt
quote: Fern Agent reads your docs site’s source repository and makes the changes you describe.
